name: rf
exec: (()=>{const T=window.THREE,S=window.__app.scene;const o=[];for(const y of [3.6,7.6,11.6,15.4,17.0]){const rc=new T.Raycaster(new T.Vector3(-86,y,-30),new T.Vector3(0,1,0));const h=rc.intersectObjects(S.children,true);o.push('y='+y+' -> '+(h[0]?h[0].object.name+'@'+h[0].point.y.toFixed(2):'SKY'));}let roof=null;S.traverse(x=>{if(x.name&&x.name.startsWith('main:roofGray'))roof=x;});if(roof){const g=roof.geometry;g.computeBoundingBox();o.push('roofBB '+JSON.stringify([g.boundingBox.min.toArray().map(v=>+v.toFixed(1)),g.boundingBox.max.toArray().map(v=>+v.toFixed(1))]));}return JSON.stringify(o)})()
